title: Fair Market Baseline — Residential Leave & Licence Agreement

fairClauses.title: Security Deposit Refund
fairClauses.text: The Licensor shall refund the full security deposit to the Licensee within 7 days of vacating the premises, subject only to deductions for unpaid utility bills or actual physical damage beyond normal wear and tear.

fairClauses.title: Mutual Lock-in Period
fairClauses.text: Both Licensor and Licensee agree to a mutual lock-in period of 1 to 3 months. After the lock-in period, either party may terminate by giving 1 month written notice.

fairClauses.title: Mutual Notice Period
fairClauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement by giving 30 days written notice to the other party.

fairClauses.title: Mutual Consent for Amendments
fairClauses.text: No modification or amendment of this agreement shall be valid unless agreed to in writing and signed by both Licensor and Licensee.
